required_outcomes: Recognises that the system assigned an agency panel provider (GreenLine Grounds) to works that the landlord's own contractor, Riverside Services, started on 20 November and that the landlord is paying for.
Tells GreenLine Grounds the job sheet is withdrawn and not to contact the tenant or attend, and records on the ticket that no agency provider is used on this job.
Keeps the request on hold waiting for the landlord's contractor to finish, with a review date about a week out and a specific ask (confirmation all items are done).
acceptable_alternatives: Asking a human to remove the provider assignment in the system if the agent cannot do so, as a low-priority request, after GreenLine has already been told to stand down.
Letting the landlord know the duplicate assignment was caught and cancelled, so he does not receive a second set of works or costs.
positive_behaviours: Notes that "Landlord approval confirmed" at event 034 refers to the landlord's go-ahead to his own contractor, not to agency spend.
Does not contact the tenant about a GreenLine visit, or corrects any impression that one is coming.
red_flags: Letting the GreenLine assignment stand while the landlord's contractor is on the job.
Escalating the case to a human instead of standing down the duplicate provider itself.
prohibited_actions: Approving a quote or spend for GreenLine Grounds.
Telling the tenant an agency contractor will visit to do the garden works.
critical_failures: Confirming or booking GreenLine Grounds to do the garden works the landlord's contractor is already doing.
